system.description:
The Kiasyd can inscribe arcane glyphs that force her own warped perceptions upon others. Few minds handle reality the way she sees it; though the wards do no direct harm, their disorienting glamour is enough to leave the unwary hopelessly lost.

Spend one turn tracing the ward on a target object with your fingertip (or ten minutes tracing it across the floor to ward an entire room) and make a Static Mental Challenge (retest Awareness) against a difficulty of seven Traits. Success means anyone who touches the object or enters the room is down two Traits on all Mental Challenges while in contact or within the room, and must also win a Static Mental Challenge against a nine-Trait difficulty or become lost until someone leads her back to familiar surroundings. To ward an item currently worn by another, make a Mental Challenge against her instead; only she is affected unless another dons the item. A ward lasts one night, extendable by one Blood Trait per additional night. A victim can be affected by only one ward at a time, and anyone who knows Chanjelin Ward is immune to all such wards.
